description: Works out the net rate from a retail price (net = retail × (1 − commission)) or the retail price from a net rate (retail = net ÷ (1 − commission)), or the same with a markup on net, then rounds the worked-out price and reports the commission the reseller really keeps after rounding. Optionally prices a child at a % of the adult price. Commission rates are negotiated; the defaults are examples. Web page: https://globalluxagency.com/tools/net-rate-sheet-generator

childRatePercent.description: Child price as a % of the adult price. 0 = none.

model.description: commission = % of the retail price; markup = % added to the net price.

price.description: The price you set, per person or per group, in the terms given by priceEntered.

priceEntered.description: retail = price is the public (rack) price, work out the net; net = price is your net, work out the retail.

ratePercent.description: Commission or markup %. Commission is capped at 95%. Default 15% is a modelling choice (midpoint of the typical retail travel agent range).

roundTo.description: Round the worked-out price to this step (0 = to 2 decimal places).

name: net-rate-sheet-generator
